insurer_name: ICICI Lombard General Insurance Company Limited
residency_requirement: Indian resident or NRI with NRI Advantage rider
sub_limits_waiting_notes: Default PED 36 months (reducible to 12 or 24 via optional cover). Specific Illness 24 months (reducible to 12 via optional cover for 2 continuous policy years). Maternity 24-month waiting. Worldwide Cover 24-month waiting (reducible to 12). Grace 30 days (15 days if monthly mode).

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Up to Annual Sum Insured plus accrued bonuses
inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Hospitalisation defined as 24+ hours unless Optional Cover 32 (Reduced Hospitalisation) opted

domiciliary_treatment.limit_text: Standard domiciliary cover up to Sum Insured

ayush_coverage.limit_text: Up to Sum Insured for AYUSH in-patient (and AYUSH Day Care via Day Care Centre definition)

maternity_coverage.limit_text: Optional Maternity Cover; benefit per Policy Schedule sum insured; 24-month waiting; covers delivery (incl. C-section) and lawful termination; mid-term migration only at renewal

newborn_coverage.limit_text: New Born Baby cover up to 90 days from birth (in-patient ≥24 hours)

organ_donor_expenses.limit_text: Donor expenses covered up to specified limit
organ_donor_expenses.notes: Provided donor is not a member of Insured family

ambulance_cover.limit_text: Road ambulance + Air ambulance available as Optional Cover; emergency services in-built

critical_illness_cover.notes: Add-on cover with own waiting period

restoration_benefit.notes: Sum insured refilled unlimited times in a policy year

preventive_health_checkup.limit_text: BeFit wellness, OPD, e-consultation and preventive check-ups
preventive_health_checkup.notes: Available via mobile app; BeFit cover entry age cap 65 at first issuance

room_rent_capping: No cap by default; Room Modifier optional cover can downgrade to 1% SI normal / 2% SI ICU per day for premium discount
copayment_trigger_notes: Voluntary co-pay optional. Specific Illness Waiting Period Reduction triggers 20% co-pay if treatment is outside Preferred Provider Network. Worldwide Cover may carry co-pay per add-on terms.

worldwide_emergency_cover.limit_text: Worldwide Cover (Optional add-on) — global hospitalisation including USA and Canada; 24-month waiting (reducible to 12)
worldwide_emergency_cover.notes: Cannot be availed by NRIs/Overseas Citizens for global cover

temporary_exclusions: 24-month specific disease waiting (reducible to 12 via optional cover)
notable_exclusions_summary: Premium global product. 30-day initial wait, default 36-month PED (reducible to 12/24 via PED Reduction add-on), 24-month specific-disease wait (reducible to 12). Worldwide Cover (USA & Canada included) requires 2-year wait. Standard IRDAI permanent exclusions apply. Maternity and New Born are optional. 20% co-pay applies if Specific Illness Reduction is used outside Preferred Provider Network.
claim_process_summary: Cashless via 7500+ network hospitals; toll-free 1800 2666; mobile app for BeFit OPD/wellness, e-consult and emergency assistance.
available_riders: Vaccinations for new born baby (first year)
